name: hf-vector-two-hop-boundary
purpose: Prospective additional fixed characterization pair, declared after both original lower wanted points (0/64 and -3/128) missed every active slot and before either new point executes. The original +20/64 and +17/128 successes leave a 20 dB (100x E/N0) gap. +6/64 and +3/128 use the same primary field, axis11, E payload, source/channel seed73613 and noise seed93613, raising the lower-pair E/N0 by 6 dB. Both points are frozen together; no retuning between them and no automatic subsequent sweep. This explicitly extends the earlier investigator-chosen no-further-bisection stopping choice, not the original frozen campaign. Existing strong and lower negative-control failures remain requirements failures; this unchanged-receiver pair is characterization, not new false-alarm calibration or a receiver repair. Stop on invalid evidence, numerical refusal or execution limits; retain valid communications failures.
